analysis.rationale: Order book of ₹288 Cr in Q1 covers 82% of FY27 target, indicating strong demand and growth trajectory. IP revenue (CYBX AI CyberOps) compounding at ₹53 Cr+ cumulative, shifting from services to IP-led model.
